description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark) v2], [Awoken Apparition Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast] and [Particle Beam Charge Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning]/[Attach Dark] after using a Lightning or Dark ability

description.name: Awoken Apparition Mode
description.text: Dark and Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Particle Beam Charge Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Particle Beam Charge after using two Lightning or Dark abilities
